text:
sam (Marketing): Hey team — new ask: a compact benchmark visualization pack we can reuse across webinar hero, email header, paid social, and a small landing module. Must be CDN-ready with canonical filenames and an assets manifest. Keep copy minimal; two messaging lanes (latency-first, cost-first). Include localized copy slots for EN, DE, FR. Deadline: next Tue EOD.

arya (Design): Clarify deliverables + formats? Any motion/animation requirements?

sam (Marketing): Exports: SVG master (simplified for email), PNG @2x for each crop, Lottie JSON for micro-animation (sparkline), and a 3-frame GIF for ads. Crops: desktop hero 1200x600, mobile 640x360, square 800x800, banner 600x200. Also need transparent PNGs for overlays.

ted (Growth): Add: brand-only no-CTA variant for lift tests, and creative_id meta tag in filenames (e.g., bench_v1_creativeA). Include two CTAs per lane and a copy-only file for ad platforms. For localization, provide short CTA translations (EN/DE/FR).

arya (Design): Will create two layout systems: "stat-panel" (big stat + sparkline) and "context-panel" (short sentence + supporting stat). Two colorways: brand blue and dark invert. Also add an accessibility-ready high-contrast colorway.

nora (Legal): Quick compliance notes: avoid absolutes (no "cheapest" or "always"). Use qualifiers: "up to" or "on typical workloads". Must include a small methodology footnote and a link. For localized copy, legal will review EN and DE; FR may be best-effort. Ping me when copy is attached.

arya (Design): Technical notes: SVGs must inline-critical styles (no external fonts) for email clients. Lottie should be <50KB if possible; keep sparkline micro animation to simple path morph + opacity. GIF size target <120KB. I'll provide an "email-safe" PNG set (flattened).

sam (Marketing): Also request an asset naming convention and manifest.json with fields: filename, creative_id, size, colorway, layout, locale, alt_text. Growth needs exact file names for ad upload.

ted (Growth): For A/Bs, include variants: CTA A = "Try the benchmark"; CTA B = "See pricing & commits"; plus a no-CTA. English, German, French short CTAs please. Also include 1-line alt text for each crop.

arya (Design): Timeline: draft mocks by Fri 11am, review 11:30, iterate, final package by Tue EOD. Deliverables list I'll hand off: 2 layouts x 2 headlines x 2 colorways x 3 crops + banner + transparent PNGs + Lottie + GIF + manifest.json + copy_slate.txt + README.

nora (Legal): I'll do a quick review of short copy within ~1 hour after you post. Note on claims: prefer "on typical production workloads" as the qualifier. Also require a tiny attribution line: "Benchmark methodology: redwood.com/bench-method".

arya (Design): Will add a small badge area for toggles ("Dedicated ready" / "SLA-ready") and an optional testimonial line slot for CRO tests. For localization, I'll expose text layers in Figma and include export guidelines for translators (char count limits).

sam (Marketing): Good. Growth asks: include two-tone dark invert + accessible high-contrast; provide exact hex swatches and WCAG pass screenshots. Also request a performance-friendly SVG fallback (simple paths, no masks) for AMP/email.

ted (Growth): Also include tracking params example for landing links (utm_source=ads&utm_campaign=bench_v1_creativeA). And a small CSV mapping filenames -> creative_id -> CTA -> locale for ad ops.

assets-bot: Uploaded initial mock_v1 to /Shared/marketing/bench-visuals/mock_v1.zip (contains fig, svg exports, png exports, README, copy_slate.txt).

sam (Marketing): Thanks — will review mock_v1 tomorrow. Aria/Aria? tagging @arya for noon check-in.

arya (Design): Mock v1 pushed to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/bench-visuals-v1 — org access. Export specs saved in the file. Will update thread when Lottie + manifest are ready. :sparkles:
